About Pelham Gardens 
Pelham Gardens, located between Pelham Parkway and the Hutchinson River Parkway, is a residential and garden-style Bronx neighborhood with curving streets and brick-and-stucco homes. The neighborhood’s character concentrates around the Pelham Parkway Greenway near White Plains Road, where small groceries, bakeries, and casual takeout counters line the corridor beside the median’s walking paths. Detached houses with driveways and tidy front yards mix with low-rise co-ops, giving the blocks a suburban-leaning rhythm. Jacobi Medical Center anchors the eastern edge with a steady daytime pulse. Bronx Park and the Bronx River corridor add wooded trails and open lawns nearby. The 5 train at Pelham Parkway links the area to the rest of the city.
